purpose: First owned standalone Sprite fixture; no new Entity type, wire schema or implemented adapter
native_shape_rule: Read actual constructed descriptors/keys and final pair; reject unsupported shape. XML counts and PNG header are not native loading or runtime indexed observations.
continuous_update: Same resource revision, exact local descriptors, array identities/counts and owner generation: preflight complete pose, no native calls or allocation during writes, publish local pose revision last. No Update/SetFrame/SetLayerFrame.
candidate_rebuild: Any resource, sheet path, main/overlay descriptor or overlay-presence change; prepare outside final draw, publish after checks, retire old owner in valid drained context.
limits: Logical resource key/revision are manually named design values, not content hashes
Existing extracted resource files are not proved to match active game resolver or remote files
Entity config id1000 variant200 only identifies a local XML association, not supported native Effect lifecycle
No runtime load, image/control state, GL output, Authority fixture source or E2E observed
